title: Priority Pointer Not Updated After Grant
bug_signature: UVM_ERROR: [FAIRNESS] Masters 1-3 each starved; last_gnt always resets to 0
rtl:
always_ff @(posedge clk)
  if (gnt_done) last_gnt <= 2'h0;  // Always restart from M0 — unfair
expected_root_cause: After each grant the priority pointer is reset to 2'h0 rather than being updated to the ID of the master just served; subsequent arbitration always restarts from master 0, permanently preventing masters 1–3 from making forward progress.
description: After issuing a grant the pointer is reset to zero rather than to the ID of the master that was just served, so arbitration always restarts from master 0.
failure_log: UVM_ERROR: [FAIRNESS] Masters 1-3 each starved; last_gnt always resets to 0
success_log: Pointer updated to last winner. Round-robin sequence progresses correctly.
